channel.title: Ilya Zakharau - Essays about Systems, People, and the In-Between
channel.description: Essays on product management, systems thinking, and the people and interfaces that connect them

item.title: My Experience with AI-First Spec-Driven Development
item.description: A hands-on account of running Spec-Driven Development with OpenSpec on a production portal — the workflow, what worked, and where it breaks down.

item.title: I dreamed about moving the requirements specification to code. Am I happy with Spec-Driven Development now?
item.description: Spec-Driven Development promised to make requirements the center of software delivery. It did. Just not the way we expected.

item.title: AI Broke Product Planning and There Is No Obvious Way to Fix That
item.description: AI-assisted development has made effort estimation wildly unpredictable. Story points are losing their last foothold, roadmaps feel like tarot cards, and the industry has no consensus on what comes next.

item.title: Can I Get a Senior Management Job by 40? Unlikely, but Let's Speculate
item.description: A personal reflection on where the PM career ladder goes when AI reshapes roles, mass layoffs hollow out middle management, and the traditional corporate path closes off.

item.title: My Main AI PM Concern is Maintaining Prompts, not Writing Them
item.description: Managing prompts throughout the development and operational lifecycle becomes a larger, unanticipated problem than writing them. Learn which issues you might encounter when pushing your AI agent from MVP to Production.

item.title: 2025 Reflections & 2026 Plans
item.description: Annual writing review: 12 articles, platform performance analysis, and content plans for 2026

item.title: How I stopped doing Product Management and became obsessed with AI evals
item.description: A product manager's practical journey through building AI evaluation frameworks - from manual Excel scoring to automated testing, and learning to live with non-deterministic outputs.

item.title: From Product Manager to Context Dealer: How AI Changed My Role
item.description: The transformation of product management in the AI era - from writing BRDs to hunting for context and building POCs

item.title: Embedding AI Features: The Messy Middle Between POC and MVP
item.description: A PM's experience designing AI-based capabilities from proof-of-concept to MVP, covering model selection, testing, prompt engineering, and managing the unpredictable nature of LLMs.

item.title: Managing Noise: The Higher You Climb the Product Manager Ladder
item.description: Exploring the challenges product managers face as they advance: dealing with increasing noise, endless conversations, and distance from implementation details.

item.title: Resolving Chronic Systemic Problems is Not Helpful for Your Career
item.description: How AI is enabling sub-optimization and making systemic problem-solving a career risk in today's employment market

item.title: How to Build and Maintain Stakeholder Trust as a Product Owner
item.description: Learn proven strategies for building stakeholder trust in any situation - from new projects to damaged relationships. Discover practical tips for managing expectations, practicing transparency, and turning around failed projects.

item.title: To Tease a Future Feature or Not to Tease?
item.description: Explore the pros and cons of announcing upcoming product features, with real-world insurance industry examples and practical strategies for product managers to handle feature communication.

item.title: Julius Caesar Was a Startup
item.description: Discover how Julius Caesar's political career parallels modern startup strategies, exploring his ambitious rise through borrowed capital, risk-taking, and eventual success in Ancient Rome.

item.title: Do We Need Junior Business Analysts?
item.description: An opinionated look at the relevance of junior Business Analyst roles in the AI-driven job market of 2025.

item.title: The Product Manager's View on Composability
item.description: Understanding composable architecture from a Product Manager's perspective, its challenges, and impact on vendor relationships

item.title: Stakeholder Alignment: The Underrated Skill Every Product Manager Needs
item.description: There is much buzz about whether AI could replace human product managers. I am not very concerned. Much of my work involves dealing with stakeholders at different levels and pursuing various objectives. AI will find it challenging to substitute that side of people interaction. I mean politics in a sense of power dynamics among multiple groups of stakeholders.

item.title: 2024 Reflections & 2025 Plans
item.description: Another year is almost over, so it is time to summarize all that happened and discuss what is coming. First, let me wish you a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year before I dive into self-reflections relevant only to a few readers.
